ESPP Calculator

Estimate employee stock purchase plan gains with discount and lookback price.

For information only — not financial advice. Assumes a lookback to the lower FMV; check your plan document.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the fair market value at the offering date and at the purchase date.
  2. Enter your plan discount % and total contribution for the period.
  3. The purchase price uses the lower of the two FMVs (lookback) minus the discount.
  4. Read shares bought, market value, gain, and return %.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the lookback?

Many ESPPs price shares using the lower of the FMV at the offering date or the purchase date, before applying the discount. This tool models that.

What is a qualifying disposition?

Holding the shares long enough (generally 2 years from offering and 1 year from purchase) can change how the discount is taxed. The gain math here is the same either way.

What if the stock fell?

The discount and lookback cushion losses. If the purchase-date FMV is below the discounted price, most plans let you withdraw instead of buying.
